info.title: API-DocTest-List Retail Orders Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Status API provides access to the current status of retail orders. This endpoint enables users to track and monitor the state of their orders, ensuring transparency and timely updates. Typical consumers include retailers and customer service teams who require real-time information to assist customers effectively. The API streamlines communication between systems, allowing for efficient order management and improved customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of their orders, providing insights into processing, shipping, or delivery stages. Utilize this to keep track of order fulfillment and inform customers accordingly.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve the status of orders. The provided data should conform to the defined schema to ensure proper processing.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the status of the orders.

ListRetailOrdersStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the operation to retrieve the status of orders.

ListRetailOrdersStatusResponse_200.title: Order Status Response

status.description: Indicates the operation status indicating success or failure.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier associated with the order.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state/status of the order.

processingTimeMs.description: Processing time for the order in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation's result.

ListRetailOrdersStatusResponse_200.description: Represents the response body structure for the order status operation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the order.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the order was created.

automated.description: Indicates if the order processing was automated.

AuditInfo.description: Contains audit information related to the order processing.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time (in milliseconds) taken to process the request. This helps in assessing the performance of the operation.
